
```{r business-cycle, results='asis'} 
if (nrow(report$business_cycle) > 0L) {
  cat(
    "**Fase:** ",
    report$business_cycle$Fase[[1]],
    "  \n",
    sep = ""
  )

  cat(
    "**Score:** ",
    report$business_cycle$Score[[1]],
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

## Nøkkeltall

```{r key-indicators, results='asis'}
table_data <- report$key_indicators |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Verdi = dplyr::case_when(
      Enhet %in% c(
        "Prosent",
        "Prosentpoeng"
      ) ~ formatC(
        Verdi,
        format = "f",
        digits = 2,
        decimal.mark = ","
      ),

      grepl(
        "^Indeks",
        Enhet
      ) ~ formatC(
        Verdi,
        format = "f",
        digits = 1,
        decimal.mark = ","
      ),

      Enhet == "Antall måneder" ~ formatC(
        Verdi,
        format = "f",
        digits = 1,
        decimal.mark = ","
      ),

      TRUE ~ formatC(
        Verdi,
        format = "f",
        digits = 2,
        decimal.mark = ","
      )
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Display_navn,
    Verdi,
    Enhet,
    Kategori,
    Kilde
  )

categories <- unique(
  table_data$Kategori
)

for (category in categories) {

  cat(
    "### ",
    category,
    "\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  category_data <- table_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Kategori == category
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Display_navn,
      Verdi,
      Enhet,
      Kilde
    )

  names(category_data)[[1]] <- "Variabel"

  print(
    knitr::kable(
      category_data,
      align = c(
        "l",
        "r",
        "l",
        "l"
      )
    )
  )

  cat("\n\n")
}
```
